newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Banking stocks drive Moroccan bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Banking stocks drive Moroccan bourse higher.

text.p: Moroccan banking stocks on Wednesday drove the Casablanca bourse higher, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index was up 0.06 percent to 433.13 points.
The index of Upline Securities which tracks the 10 most liquid stocks was 56,202, up from 56,161 points.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest capitalisation, rose nine dirhams to 700 dirhams.

"The banking sector remains the main engine behind the bourse index rise this week...The bourse is gaining momentum as local investors show an increasing interest in market blue chips," a trader said.
ONA Group, the country's largest private conglomerate, was traded at 470 dirhams, up two dirhams over the previous session.
Wafabank, one of the main active banks, remained stable at 500 dirhams, a figure it has held for nearly two weeks.
Societe Cherifienne des Petroles, rose two points to close at 502 dirhams.
The traded volume on the official market was 36.8 million, down from 42.02 million dirhams on Tuesday.
